scenario: `len(s)` gate does not fire when the string does not match. A rule gated on `len(m.text) == 3` must NOT fire for a 5-character string. Fact count remains 1 after pump.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule trig:
    Msg m where len(m.text) == 3
->
    emit Hit logical dummy: 0
